answer: Collateralized capital lockup, enforced through quadratic staking erosion and liquidity-sink commitments, creates a super-linear marginal attack cost. This mechanism ensures that the economic pulse of any Sybil cluster aiming to harbor a consensus attack faces capital expenditure that grows disproportionately to extracted value. The protocol's security threshold is thus sustained, making an assault as economically unfeasible as mass-producing saffron.
